chrome_web_store.summary: Connect ChatGPT and Web AI to local Herdr workspaces with Control Center, safe continuity, handoff, and queued next turns.
chrome_web_store.description:
Herdr connects supported Web AI conversations to your local Herdr workspaces.

OPEN YOUR LOCAL WORKSITE FROM THE BROWSER
• Use the Chrome Side Panel Control Center to see live workspaces, panes, and agents.
• Bind the current browser conversation to the right Herdr workspace.
• Pin an explicit local target and send trusted local Agent prompts through Native Messaging.

KEEP LONG WORK MOVING
• Wake the bound Web AI when local Agent output changes or a work round settles, so the Web planner can inspect, integrate, and verify the result after its previous browser turn has ended.
• Monitor long-conversation pressure with bounded state rather than unbounded browser history.
• Queue a clear next-turn message while the current answer is still running.
• Use safe handoff and bounded recovery when a long-running conversation needs to continue elsewhere.
• 429 responses back off; recovery does not blindly resubmit the original user task.

LOCAL-FIRST SECURITY
• The extension uses Chrome Native Messaging and a local mode-0600 Unix socket to reach herdr-mcp.
• Herdr bearer tokens are not stored in page scripts or browser storage.
• Local Control Center state does not require a public Cloudflare connection.
• Risky or unsupported actions remain explicitly preview-only or return an exact capability result.

SUPPORTED AND EXPERIMENTAL SURFACES
• ChatGPT is the primary supported conversation surface.
• Claude continuity support remains available where the current adapter supports it.
• chat.z.ai and chat.deepseek.com are experimental integrations. Both are disabled by default and must be enabled separately in Herdr Settings.

REQUIREMENTS
Install Herdr and the herdr-mcp local runtime first, then run `herdr-mcp native-host install`. The extension is optional for the core ChatGPT Connector workflow.

Herdr is open source. Documentation, source, support, and privacy details are linked from the store listing.
chrome_web_store.single_purpose: Connect supported Web AI conversations to the user's local Herdr/herdr-mcp workstation so the extension can show live workspace and pane state, bind the current browser conversation to a workspace, preserve long-task and long-conversation continuity, queue the user's next turn, and provide bounded recovery and trusted local control UI in the Chrome Side Panel.
chrome_web_store.review_notes: Install the matching herdr-mcp runtime, run `herdr-mcp native-host install`, then open a ChatGPT conversation and the Herdr Side Panel. The Control Center should show local runtime/workspace state and allow explicit workspace binding. z.ai and DeepSeek are experimental and OFF by default; enabling either requests Chrome access only to that exact site before its packaged content scripts register. A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint likewise requests only its configured origin when the user saves/tests it. No remote code is loaded.
